summary: @servicetitan/standalone-feature-flags preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated single-line bundle featuring a rotate-shift string decoder and a large integer/string table from which values are reassembled at runtime. The package advertises itself as an OpenFeature/LaunchDarkly wrapper (`dist/index.js`); the wrapper library code is unrelated to and does not require a second language runtime or a large opaque payload at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper shape — pulling in Bun specifically to execute a bundle whose behavior is intentionally hidden — runs automatically on `npm install` before the consumer sees any package code, and the obfuscated payload's actual behavior (network destinations, credential reads, persistence) is concealed behind the decoder.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
